description: A cache header that is not a valid signed token is ignored, not rejected.

expected_holocron.notes: An unverifiable token is ignored as if absent and a new one is issued. Upstream tokens fail Holocron's signature check the same way (docs/decisions/0005, cache tokens bound to their website).
